flows:
Navigate to https://ecommerce-playground.lambdatest.io then In the header search bar, select 'All Categories' in the category dropdown.
Type 'iphone' in the 'Search For Products' box.
Click the SEARCH button.
Get what the page shows after that and save as {{what_happened}}.
Verify that the search results list at least one product whose name contains 'iPhone'.
